rubric.why: Silver is used to make jewellery and ornaments.
rubric.description: Gives one use of silver in jewellery or ornaments.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for one valid use.

rubric.why: Silver is also used to make coins and silverware and in photography, mirrors and electrical applications.
rubric.description: Gives a second, distinct use of silver.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a valid use distinct from the first; do not award twice for the same use.

modelAnswer: Silver is used for making jewellery and ornaments.
It is also used for making coins.
